data.title: 间桐樱 · 雨中车站·伞下守候与安静侧颜
data.description: 【间桐樱 · 雨中车站·伞下守候与安静侧颜】淅淅沥沥的冬雨中，樱撑着一把淡粉色的雨伞静静伫立在车站出站口。雨水溅湿了她的裙摆，但看到你走出闸机的那一瞬间，她清澈的紫眸里立刻盈满了全部的光彩——「学长！太好了，我一直很担心你没带伞……只要能等到学长，无论等多久都不冷。」
data.promptProse: Sakura raises her eyes in relief beneath a pale-pink umbrella outside the station exit as her awaited companion passes the unseen gates. One hand holds the shaft and the other rests on her closed winter coat; a damp skirt hem shows below. The medium view includes the exit canopy and puddles near her shoes. Overcast light softly illuminates the umbrella fabric and her face, with canopy reflections trembling in the rainwater.
data.location: 车站出站口外的冬雨中
data.action: 撑淡粉伞在出站口外等候，看到同行者出闸机后抬眼微笑
